beats.command: env -u THREDZ_API_KEY crewhaus compile live/crewhaus.yaml -o live/dist --check

verify.note: GREEN (exit 0) — assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated (boot reached its MCP server credentials gate — full boot needs the MCP server credentials the spec declares). The bundle's own boot still exits 21 with the ConfigError naming THREDZ_API_KEY; what changed is --check's classification of it. Until factory PR #345 (audit item 9) an unset MCP env ref was reported as a structural boot FAILURE, so this beat asserted RED/exit 1 — but --check boots credential-free by design (scrubbed env, empty --env-file, no --allow-env), so such a spec could never go green and RED was indistinguishable from a genuinely broken bundle; the same $THREDZ_API_KEY ref in this repo's channel-shape specs was already gated-green. `env -u` makes the beat deterministic whatever the operator's .env holds.

beats.label: Now hand it a key — and watch nothing change
beats.cue: Same command, key supplied: byte-identical output, same named gate. --check boots with a scrubbed environment on purpose, so a key in your shell never reaches the bundle. The verdict is structural, not credential-dependent.
beats.script: Same command, key supplied: byte-identical output, same named gate. --check boots with a scrubbed environment on purpose, so a key in your shell never reaches the bundle. The verdict is structural, not credential-dependent. [[pause:1.5s]] The terminal is exercising the real implementation locally here, and the verifier expects a successful exit. The point of the beat: same GREEN, same MCP-server-credentials gate, same 11 anchors as prove-gate.

verify.note: the point of the beat: same GREEN, same MCP-server-credentials gate, same 11 anchors as prove-gate. --check passes only PATH/HOME/proxy/CA through and boots with an empty --env-file, so neither an exported key nor a colocated .env can satisfy an MCP env ref here — which is exactly why supplying one changes nothing on screen. Was expectedExit 1 before factory PR #345 reclassified an unset MCP credential from boot-failed to boot-gated; see prove-gate. A real key is verified by `crewhaus run` in Beat 3 instead.
